early.name: Stalker
early.annotation: Great damage and stats in lane and gives you move speed for chasing. The foostep sound reduction is also nice. And this gives you wallhacks from the DoT. This is also for the weapon investment bonus.

mid.name: Torment Pulse
mid.annotation: Great damage over the course of a game/fight. And makes you a little tankier. Also helps with farming. Just super good core item for us. Gets us our 4.8k spirit investment.

mid.name: Lifestrike
mid.annotation: Tons of healing from your 2 and melees. Keeps you alive in fights. It's 200+ health heal on a 4 sec CD.

mid.name: Point Blank
mid.annotation: Feels pretty good. It is now fixed for your 2! Difficult on slots though. Good for melee resist if you need that.

mid.name: Spirit Snatch
mid.annotation: Spirit resist and power steal is amazing. Plus even more melee damage and it procs on your 2.

late.name: Arctic Blast
late.annotation: Really great item, great for catching people and for clearing waves in cat form. The combo with it is Arctic Blast, 2 immediately so the AB travels with you, light punch, 1, 4.

late.name: Transcendent Cooldown
late.annotation: Great item once you have 2 actives. It also makes Torment Pulse tick faster! Very good with Ethereal Shift in particular.

late.name: Escalating Exposure
late.annotation: This with Scourge is insane. You run into the middle of the enemy team with Scourge and they take like 2-4k damage. Also has shred and gives you even more spirit resist so you're even tankier.

late.name: Scourge
late.annotation: Usually after Arctic Blast. Makes you really tanky and can do a lot of damage if you get into the middle of their team. You can rush earlier if you feel it would be good or have the money.

late.name: Spirit Burn
late.annotation: Anti-heal + more burst damage. If you need to burst carries this is really useful.

late.name: Colossus
late.annotation: Melee damadge and tankiness. Pick between this and Ethereal Shift for your last active slot, or sell Dispel Magic.

late.name: Ethereal Shift
late.annotation: They doubled the CD on it so it's way worse, still might be good though on Calico. Helps you live much longer. Great with Transcendent CD. You can skip for more damage if you're not dying.

late.name: Spellbreaker
late.annotation: Incredible against Lash, Grey Talon, and any other spirit burst characters.
